title: Neebu Sarbat
description: Neebu Sarbat (Neebu Ka Sarbat/Lemon Syrup) is a sweet and tangy syrup rich in Vitamin C, prepared from concentrated natural lemon juice. This classical formulation combats dehydration. Stimulates digestive juices. Cures nausea. Improves low appetite. Balances electrolytes.
dosage: 20–30 ml mixed in a glass of water with a pinch of black salt or cumin powder as preferred
